description: Name the people who may approve a wiki page — or, with signatures: true, ask them to SIGN it — and tell each of them: they get a notification that opens the page. 'who' is usernames or e-mails as 'a,b' — each must be able to read the page. Somebody already named is asked again, about the edition the page is at now. With release: true the people in 'who' are taken OFF the list instead; what they already approved stays approved. Approval (the default): the project's lead, the company's owner or an admin only, and the newest approved edition is in force. Signatures (signatures: true, which switches the page to them; the page's 'mode' says which it is): the page's author or anybody who may edit it asks, and what counts is who signed the edition the page is at NOW — a new edition is unsigned until signed again, and the people asked are waiting on it again without being asked again. Switching a page that already has lines in its journal is the lead's.

note.description: A line for the people asked — what changed, by when.

release.description: true to take these people off the page's list instead of asking them.

signatures.description: true to ask for signatures of the current edition (and read the page as signatures from now on), false to read it as approval; leave out to keep the page's mode.

who.description: Usernames or e-mails, as 'a,b'. Take them from list_users.

name: ask_wiki_page_approval
title: Ask wiki page approval
